column1: # K1: clipboard additions (format: see the header of ../hub)

column9: Newest image of the clipboard history (else the newest file in ~/pics/screenshots) goes back into the clipboard and is pasted into the previous window, even when text was copied after it.

Rewrites the generated twins (ghostty, tmux, zsh, rofi, fzf helpers, nvim langmap) from ~/.config/layout/keymap.tsv. Run after adding tmux binds, then reload ghostty (CTRL+SHIFT+comma) and tmux (prefix r).
